questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Microeconomics. according to the law of demand, other things equal, when price rises quantity demanded generally:
questions.explanation: The law of demand describes an inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded, ceteris paribus.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Statistics. the arithmetic mean is calculated by:

options.A: Sum of observations divided by number of observations

questions.explanation: The mean is the total of observations divided by their count.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Microeconomics. a movement along a demand curve is caused by a change in:
questions.explanation: A change in the commodity’s own price causes movement along a given demand curve.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Macroeconomics. gDP at market prices measures:

options.A: Value of final goods and services produced within domestic territory

questions.explanation: GDP measures final production within the domestic territory over a period.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Money and Banking. the central bank generally acts as:

options.A: Banker to the government and regulator of monetary policy

questions.explanation: Central banks manage monetary policy and provide banking services to government.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Statistics. the median is the:
questions.explanation: The median divides ordered observations into two equal halves.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Microeconomics. a perfectly inelastic demand curve is:
questions.explanation: Quantity demanded does not change with price, so the curve is vertical.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Macroeconomics. inflation refers to:

options.A: A sustained rise in the general price level
options.C: A rise in one product price only

questions.explanation: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing National Income. which is excluded from current GDP to avoid double counting?
questions.explanation: Intermediate goods are embodied in final goods and are not counted separately.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Government Budget. a fiscal deficit occurs when:

options.A: Total expenditure exceeds total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit measures the government’s borrowing requirement.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Market Forms. under perfect competition, an individual firm is generally a:
questions.explanation: A firm accepts the market-determined price in perfect competition.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Statistics. a positive correlation indicates that two variables tend to:
questions.explanation: Positive correlation means higher values of one variable tend to accompany higher values of the other.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Balance of Payments. the current account records transactions involving:

options.A: Goods, services, income and current transfers

questions.explanation: The current account includes trade, services, primary income and current transfers.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Demand and Supply. a rightward shift of the supply curve generally indicates:
questions.explanation: At each price, producers are willing to supply a larger quantity.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.question: April challenge: During concept consolidation, a Class 11 learner is reviewing Macroeconomics. a rise in the repo rate is generally intended to:

options.A: Make borrowing costlier and moderate demand

questions.explanation: A higher policy rate can tighten monetary conditions and moderate inflationary pressure.
questions.subject: Economics
